@@U00565@@
Then you'll be the man!
Then you'll be the clever one!
You're well built—well enough, at least—
you're not backward, not lacking in sense,
so trust yourself and others will trust you.
But above all else, learn to manage women!
Their eternal moaning and groaning,
their thousand pains and complaints,
so multifarious in their variety,
can be cured with a bit of pressure at the right point.
A soupcon of discretion,
and you'll have them eating out of your hand.
First, of course, it helps to be an M.D.;
it makes them assume your skill
and you win their confidence.
You'll have opened for you all the riches of the Orient,
luxurious gardens vast in number,
that ordinary men spend years trying to conquer.
No delay for you, though:
a fumble here, a fumble there,
you finger the merchandise.
You'll know just where to squeeze that little pulse,
then clasp her round her slender hips
to see how tightly she’s laced.

@@U00567@@
That’s more like it!
At least you know what you're after.

@@U00569@@
Dear friend, theory is a gray affair,
and the golden tree of life is green.

@@U00571@@
It’s all like a dream, I swear.
May I trouble you again,
and truly get to the bottom of your wisdom?
°C ORs
translation:
@@U00565@@
那你就是男人了！
那你就是那个聪明的人了！
你体格很好——至少足够好——
你并不落后，也不缺乏理智，
所以相信自己，别人也会相信你。
但最重要的是，学会管理女性！
他们永恒的呻吟和呻吟，
他们千千万万的痛苦和抱怨，
它们的种类如此繁多，
在适当的位置施加一点压力即可治愈。
谨慎的汤，
然后你就会让他们从你的手中吃掉。
首先，当然，成为一名医学博士是有帮助的；
这让他们假设你的技能
你赢得了他们的信任。
你将为你打开东方所有的财富，
数量众多的豪华花园，
普通人花费数年时间试图征服的东西。
不过，没有耽搁你：
这里摸索，那里摸索，
你用手指触摸商品。
你就会知道该在哪里挤压那个小脉冲，
然后搂住她纤细的臀部
看看她的鞋带系得有多紧。

@@U00567@@
那就更像了！
至少你知道自己在追求什么。

@@U00569@@
亲爱的朋友，理论是灰色的事情，
金生命之树是绿色的。

@@U00571@@
这一切就像一场梦，我发誓。
可以再麻烦你一下吗
并真正了解你的智慧？
°C OR
